racialSpecialty.name: Shapeshifting (Alteri)
racialSpecialty.description: Alteri can mimic the general physical characteristics of any race. An Alteri maintains a list of Shifts they can perform (up to 2 times Racial level). Additional Shifts are learned using 'list' rules and require extended contact with a member of that race.

skills.name: Climb
skills.description: Allows the user to ascend surfaces.

skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.description: Allows the user to perform feats of agility.

skills.name: Analyze
skills.description: Allows the user to gain more information by Examining Aura.

classSpecialties.name: Martial Feature
classSpecialties.description: Gain a Martial type Feature of your choice.

classSpecialties.name: War Charge
classSpecialties.description: When performing a charge, increase your move speed by (5 x 1/2 char level)ft. (round up to nearest 5ft)
